tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (pa)༄༅/ /'chi med tshe sgrub dbang chog don gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dang*
(pa)༄༅/ /'chi med tshe sgrub dbang chog don gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dang*

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// 'chi med tshe sgrub dbang chog don gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen po thob la phyag 'tshal lo// yi dam gyi lha gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes gnang ba'i tshe sgrub 'di la/ cho ga sbyor ba dngos gzhi 'jug gsum yod pa las/ dang po sbyor ba'i cho ga la/ rdzas yo byad sta gon la gnas pa/ bla ma sta gon la gnas pa/ slob ma sta gon la gnas pa dang gsum mo// rdzas yo byad sta gon la gnas pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sta gon la gnas pa/ bum pa sta gon la gnas pa/ mchod rdzas sta gon la gnas pa dang gsum mo// dang po dkyil 'khor ni/ sa la spos chus chag chag btab la/ tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor rab rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor legs par bri/ phyag na rdo rje dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas pa rdzogs par bri/ 'bring pad+ma 'dab brgyad dam/ tha ma snam bu dkar po'i steng du nas kyi tshom bu lha'i grangs dgod/ yol ba bla bre la sogs yod na bkram/ bum pa ni rin po che'i bum pa'am/ rdza'i bum pa chu bre gang yan chad shong ba la/ chu ni 'bab chu gtsang ma/ chu mig lkug pa ma yin pa'i chu gtsang ma rgyun mi chad pa 'bab pa nas blug bum rdzas ni rin po che rnam pa lnga/

gser dngul mu men byu ru mu tig snying po rnam pa lnga/ gser tshwa mar sbrang rtsi bu ram/ 'bru rnam pa lnga/ nas 'bras til gro sran ma/ dri rnam pa lnga/ tsan dan ga bur ka ko la gur gum gi wang*/ sman rnam pa lnga/ kaṇ+ḍa ka rī sle tres rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dbang lag shu dag dkar po/ lnga tshan lnga po de rnams phye ma byas la/ spra tshil gyi nang du bsdams la bum pa'i nang du gzhug phyi la ras dkar gyi na bza' gsol/ mgul chings ras kha tshar ma nyams pa rab bdun/ 'bring lnga/ tha ma gsum/ oṃ kalpa bṛk+ṣā swā hā/ zhes pas mgul chings legs par bcings so// bum pa'i kha rgyan ni shing 'bras bu can la bya'o// rdo rje dang tshon sna lnga'i gzungs thag kha rgyan khrod du gzhug go /de ni phyag na rdo rje'i khrus chog gi bum pa yin/ tshe dpag med kyi bum pa ni/ rab rin po che'i bum pa'am rdza'i bum pa/ 'bring tshe bum zlum po/ tha ma snod gang yang rung ba gas chag med pa gu gul gyis legs par bdugs la/ bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags 'dis bskrad do// rab tu byung ba la zho dang 'o mas bkang ngo*// mi nag pa la chang phud gtsang mas bkang ngo*// de rnams bum pa'i sta gon yin/ 'brang rgyas ni/ phud phye gtsang ma ma nyams pa bre gang yan chad la/ tshe 'phel bar byed pa'i rdzas ni/ rab dkar gsum mngar gsum/ 'bras bu gsum/ dbang lag rtag tu ngu*/ cong zhi/ snying po rnam pa lnga sogs pa tshe 'phel bar byed pa'i rdzas rnams gdab/ 'brang rgyas kyi dbyibs zlum po/ ngos dkar la 'jam pa/ mar 'jam pos legs par byugs la/ de'i steng du mar gyi rdo rje rgya gram/ rtse la rdo rje rtse lnga pa nyi zlas brgyan pa/ rin po che 'bar ba bzhi/ drwa ba/ drwa phyed/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ lnga bkod/ de'i tha ma tshe ril gyis legs par bkang la/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba legs par bsham/

'brang rgyas de ni tshe chang gi steng du bzhag tshe mda' gas chag med pa/ de la bla g.yu/ tshe dar dmar po la tshe dpag med pa'i snying po bris la 'brang rgyas la 'dzugs/ des ni bum pa 'brang rgyas dang bcas pa'i sta gon bstan/ mchod rdzas bsham pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnam pa lnga legs par bsham/ gtor ma lnga bsham/ gtor ma dar la sogs pas legs par brgyan/ des rdzas yo byad sta gon la gnas pa bstan/ gnyis pa bla ma sta gon la gnas pa ni/ bla ma bslab pa gsum dang ldan pa/ byams snying rje byang chub gyi sems dang ldan pa/ rab yi dam lha yi zhal gzigs pa/ 'bring bsnyen pa'i rtags tshad du phyin pa/ tha ma grangs bsnyen them pa'o// gsum pa slob ma sta gon la gnas pa ni/ sgo gsum bla ma la gus shing*/ bla mas ci gsung sgrub pa/ gtong phod che ba/ srod dang tho rangs la ni mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa/ dam tshig la gnas pa zhig dgos/ de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon la gnas pa bstan pa'o// de yan chad kyis sbyor ba'i cho ga bstan no// dngos gzhi tshe sgrub par byed pa la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi 'jug gsum/ dang po sbyor ba tshogs gsog par byed pa la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang nyid 'dug pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid lcang lo can gyi gnas rdo rje'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ mtha' rdo rje rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ de'i phyi rim la gser gyi sdong po la g.yu'i lo 'dab rgyas pa/ g.yu'i sdong po la gser gyi lo 'dab rgyas pa/ rin po che rā ga'i sdong po la shel gyi lo 'dab rgyas pa/ shel gyi sdong po la rin po che rā ga'i lo 'dab rgyas pa/ bai ḍū r+ya'i sdong po la in+d+ra nī la'i lo 'dab rgyas pa/ in+d+ra nī la'i sdong po la bai ḍūr+ya'i lo 'dab rgyas pa/ de rnams kyi rtse la bya spu sdug pa dang ldan pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa/

lcang lo can gyi gnas sam/ bde ba can gyi zhing du bsam/ rang lus skad cig dran rdzogs kyis phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon pas dngul dkar gyi dril bu dku la brten pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu rigs lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa zhig bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ mthing ga 'od dang ldan pa zhig tu byin gyis brlab/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las mdun du pam̐ zhig chad pa'i pam̐ 'od du zhu bas pad+ma'i sdong po cha gsum pa zhig bsam/ dbus kyi lte ba la bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa bla ma dang tha mi dad pa/ tshe 'dzin bkra shis kyi lha mo rnams kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par bzhugs par bsam/ g.yas kyi pad+ma'i sdong po la bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la rig sngags kyi khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ dngos grub ster ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsam/ g.yon phyogs kyi pad+ma'i sdong po la chos skyong ba'i srung ma pho rgyud mo rgyud dang bcas pa/ bar chad srung zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i tshul du bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med/ lcang lo can gyi gnas nas phyag na rdo rje/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams skad cig gis spyan 'dren par bsams la/ tshig 'dis spyan drang ngo*// bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de// 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// sems can don la dgongs pa'i 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum// yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru// rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas// bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// tshe 'dzin lha mo'i 'khor dang bcas// tshe dang bsod nams spel ba'i phyir// smon lam thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// bdag dang sems can rgyud sbyang phyir// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyang*// bar chad ma lus srung ba'i phyir// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/

na mo gu ru/ bud+dha/ dharma/ saṃ gha/ a pa ri mi te/ badz+ra pā ṇī/ ma ma ma hā kā la ya bud+dha bo dhi satwa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ so so'i dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas tshogs gsog pa la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs la/ dag pa bla ma yi dam la brten nas tshogs gsog pa dang*/ ma dag pa khams gsum 'khor ba la brten nas tshogs gsog pa yin te/ dag pa bla ma yi dam la brten nas tshogs gsog pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun sde la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum la rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis// khyed kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la// tshe dang ye shes sbyin mdzad pa'i// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes de ltar phyag 'tshal lo// phyag btsal nas rgyas par byed na/ bzang po spyod pa'i sgo nas yan lag bdun rnam dag bya/ bsdus pa byed na/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i sprin phung ji snyed yod pa rnams// blo yis blangs nas ma lus 'bul bar bgyi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba bgyid la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi lus kyang 'bul bar bgyi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// dge ba gang bsags byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes brjod pa'i phyi la/

sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// zhes pa nas// sbyin pa mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag rgyu sbyor rnams la rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs phar phyin drug gi bstod pa bya/ de dag ni dag pa lha dang bla ma la brten nas tshogs bsag pa yin/ ma dag pa khams gsum 'khor ba la brten nas tshogs bsag pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba'i rgyu mtha' dag dang ldan par gyur cig ces byams pa bsgom/ ma rgan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral bar gyur cig ces snying rje bsgom/ ma rgan sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khod par gyur cig ces dga' ba bsgom/ sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i smon pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgom bzlas bya snyam pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed bsgom/ des bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyis tshogs zhing gi ye shes kyi lha gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi thugs kar bsdu/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can la phog sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag nas/ 'od du zhu rang la bsdu/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog 'od du zhu rang la bsdu/ rang 'od du zhu thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ pad gdan zla ba'i gdan la thim/ zla ba'i gdan zhabs kyu la bsdu/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu/ 'a la bsdu/ 'a ha la bsdu/ ha dpung pa la bsdu/ dpung pa mgo la bsdu/ mgo zla tshes la bsdu/ zla tshes thig le la bsdu/ thig le je chung la song*/ til tsam du song*/ til tsam pa de la ci tsam gnas kyi bar du bzhag

rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed de/ chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ ci'i yang ngo bor ma grub pa/ yod med kyi rtog pa ma shar bar lhod cher glod la bzhag de ye shes kyi tshogs yin/ lta sgom spyod gsum gyi lta ba'ang yin/ dngos gzhi lha bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid 'di hūm̐ mthing ga zhig tu bsgom/ hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'og tu e zhig chad pas/ e las nam mkha' mthing nag 'bar ba mtha' dbus med pa es mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yam̐ zhig chad pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu yam̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig bsgom/ de'i steng du ram̐ zhig chad pas/ me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa ram̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du bam̐ zhig chad pas/ de 'od du zhu bas chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar la zlum pa bam̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig bsgom/ de'i steng du lam̐ zhig chad pas/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi lam̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du sum̐ zhig chad pas/ dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba rin po che sna lnga las grub pa zur bzhi logs brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du hūm̐ de las pam̐ zhig chad pas/ pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bsam/ de'i steng du ram̐ zhig chad pas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba/ de dang mnyam pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las hūm̐ zhig chad pas/ sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig bsam/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer sa gzhi la 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs la 'phros pas rdo rje'i rtsig pa/ steng la 'phros pas rdo rje'i thog rdo rje 'phros pas rdo rje chung ngus drwa mig bkag pa/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i gur/ rdo rje'i rwa ba bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar bar bsam/ rdo rje rgya gram lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la phog pas me ri ru gyur/

steng gi me lce 'og tu 'phro ba/ 'og gi me lce steng du 'phro ba/ me'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs pa/ me ri'i mtshams las bgegs ma 'da' zhig hūm̐ de las bh+rūm̐ zhig chad pas/ gzhal yas khang rin po che lnga las grub pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bang rim bzhi pa/ drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ 'dod yon snam bu/ gdugs chos 'khor rtsa brgyad mchod rten/ rin po che'i pha gu/ gser gyi ka ba la g.yu'i gdung ma/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bsam/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing ga la yod pa la/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing ga zhig bsam ste/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa phul/ thugs mnyes dngos grub thams cad tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon brkyangs pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ klu rigs lnga'i ngo bo sbrul brgyad kyis sku la brgyan te/ rgyal rigs dkar pos dbu la brgyan pa/ rje'u rigs ser khras snyan rgyan/ bram ze'i rigs dmar khras mgul rgyan dang ska rags/ dmangs rigs ljang khras phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/ gdol pa nag po'i do shal dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra khams ser gyen la brdzes pa/ zhabs bgrad cing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra ag tshom la me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba me ri'i dkyil na bzhugs par bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i spyi gtsug tu mi bskyod pa tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/

phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ des rang dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa bstan/ bum pa la dmigs pa ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa de/ bh+rūm̐ las phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang du bsams la/ bum pa'i chu la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsir bsam/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang ji ltar bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i phyag na rdo rje bskyed/ de'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ des yi dam phyag na rdo rje bskyed pa yin/ de nas 'brang rgyas la dmigs pa gtad pa ni/ swa bhā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi 'brang rgyas kyi rnam pa la/ nang gzhal yas khang du yod pa/ phyi'i rgyan rnams kyang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa 'od du 'bar ba zhig tu bsam/ de lta bur grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ rin po che seng ge'i khri'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas oṃ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo/ g.yon pa mnyam bzhag gi steng na tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ thugs dam bskul nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bsgom/ de bzhin du shar du glang po che bsnol pa'i khri'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa'/ lhor rta mchog bsnol ba'i khri'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu rma bya bsnol ba'i khri'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas/

byang du shang shang bsnol ba'i khri'i steng du don yod grub pa/ steng phyogs kun tu bzang mo/ shar lhor sangs rgyas spyan ma/ lho nub mā ma kī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du dam tshig sgrol ma/ g.yas na rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ g.yon na tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo brtan ma dngul gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ shar du lcags kyu ma g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon na tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ des 'gre'o// lhor zhags pa ma= nub tu lcags sgrog ma= byang du dril bu ma= gru chad bzhi la/ shar du lā se ma dkar mo dung phreng can/ lhor mā le ma sngon mo g.yu phreng can/ nub tu gī ti ma dmar mo dbang phreng can/ byang du nirti ma ljang gu gser phreng can/ kun kyang phyag g.yas na tshe'i g.yab dar bsnams pa/ g.yon na tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ tshe mda' srog gi rten du 'dzugs pa bla g.yu tshe yi rtags su 'dzugs pa/ tshe dar le rgan g.yab tu 'dor ba/ tshe bum zlum po rten du 'dzugs pa/ de ltar bsams te/ de ni tshe'i 'brang rgyas la dmigs pa'o// da ni chang gi dmigs pa ni/ phyi tshe zlum gyi rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang du yod pa'o// tshe chang la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ ta/ tshe bh+rūm̐/ ā bh+rūm̐/ yu bh+rūm̐/ zhes brjod pas tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams la/ de yi steng du pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhig bsam/ de'i 'dab ma re re'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsam/ de'i steng du hrīḥdamar po re bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas don gnyis byas/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dpag med/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa tshe dpag med/ byang shar du kun gzigs tshe dpag med/

shar lhor yon tan tshe dpag med/ lho nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo ba tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i nyams can sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ de rnams kyi thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po re re bsam/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgoms pa'i lha rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams gong gi spyan drang ba'i tshig rnams brjod pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la khra mer mer byon par bsams la/ dzaḥzhes pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes pas thim par bsam/ bam̐ zhes pas 'dres/ hoḥzhes pas dgyes shing brtan par bsam/ de ltar gnyis su med par bsgoms pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ yang rang dang bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams thugs ka nas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar nar gyis babs pas/ rang dang bum pa gnyis ka ltem gyis khengs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a pa ri mi te ā yur+dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa'i dzab ci mang du bgrang*/ thog mar bar chad sel ba'i don du/ phyag na rdo rje'i bum pa la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bum pa'i kha nang nas gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bskor bar bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med par bsam/

de rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi babs pas/ bum pa'i nang thams cad bdud rtsis dkar mer gyis gang bar bsam/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku las kyang bdud rtsi babs par bsams shing*/ badz+ra pā ṇ-i'i sngags ci mang du bzla/ bzlas pa'i rjes la bstod pa dang*/ bdun rnam dag bya/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ rig sngags kyi khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs su gyur pa khyed rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi phyi'i bar du gcod pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ nang gi bar du gcod pa nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ da 'brang rgyas la dmigs te/ 'od zer spro bsdu phyag len ltar byed cing*/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ dbus phyogs seng chen bsnol ba'i khri steng na// rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med// phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'bar ba bsnams// dbus phyogs nam mkha'i bdud bcom mo// g.yon na tshe yi bum pa bsnams// bum pa mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe yis bkang*// kha rgyan mi 'gyur dpag bsam shing*// mgul chings mi 'gyur le brgan rtsi// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe stsol srog skyobs shig oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ā yu pha la sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐ yu bh+rūm̐ yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ ā yur dz+nyā na yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ a pa ri mi te yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ gzungs ring ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dz+nyā na su bi ni sh+tsi ta/ te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shud+dhe/ dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā

'dir mi spel 'jug re swā hā/ shar phyogs glang chen bsnol ba'i khri steng na// zhes sogs gong gi 'gres so/ rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med// phyag g.yas rdo rje= /shar phyogs sa yi= /g.yon na tshe yi= /bum pa mi 'gyur= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /shar gyi phyogs nas tshe stsol= gong gi dzab bzla/ lho phyogs rta mchog bsnol= /rin chen 'byung ldan= /phyag g.yas rin chen= /lho phyogs me yi= /g.yon na= /bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe= /lho yi phyogs nas tshe= /dzab dang gzungs ring gong gi 'gres so// nub phyogs rma bya bsnol= snang ba mtha' yas= /phyag g.yas pad+ma= /nub phyogs chu yi= /g.yon na= /bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe yis= /nub kyi phyogs nas tshe= /dzab dang gzungs ring bzla/ byang phyogs shang shang bsnol ba'i= /don yod grub pa= /phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram= /byang phyogs rlung gi= /g.yon na= /bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe yis= /byang gi phyogs nas= skabs 'dir gong gi dzab rnams dang*/ lha re'i thugs dam bskul ba'i rjes la tshar gsum gsum la sogs ci mang du bzla/ gzungs ring 'og ma tshar gcig brjod/ shar lho'i mtshams nas tshe 'dzin ma// rdo rje lha mo sangs rgyas spyan// phyag g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon na dung gi bum pa bsnams// bum pa mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe yis bkang*// kha rgyan mi 'gyur dpag bsam shing*// mgul chings mi 'gyur le brgan rtsi// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// shar lho mtshams nas tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /dzab dang gzungs ring gong bzhin bzla/ lho nub mtshams nas tshe 'dzin ma// rin chen lha mo mā ma kī// phyag g.yas rin chen 'bar ba= /g.yon na g.yu yi bum pa= /bum pa mi= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe yis= /lho nub mtshams nas tshe= /nub byang mtshams nas tshe 'dzin ma// pad+ma'i lha mo gos dkar mo// phyag g.yas pad+ma 'bar ba=

/g.yon na byu ru bum= /bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe yi= /nub byang mtshams nas= /byang shar mtshams nas tshe 'dzin ma// las kyi lha mo sgrol ma che// phyag g.yas rgya gram= /g.yon na margad bum pa= /bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje= /byang shar mtshams nas tshe stsol= /gong gi dzab bzla/ steng gi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma// rdo rje lha mo kun bzang yum// phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams// bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe yis= /steng gi phyogs nas= /'og gi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma// sa yi lha mo brtan ma ni// phyag na dngul gyi bum pa= /bum pa= /kha rgyan= /mgul chings= /rdo rje tshe= /'og gi phyogs nas tshe= /shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// rdo rje lha mo lcags kyu ma// phyag na lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams// shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bla tshe khug /srid pa'i ma mo'i lag nas bla= /bdud dang gshin rje'i lag nas bla= lha dang gnod sbyin lag nas= /klu dang sa bdag lag= /gnyan chen sde lnga'i= /rgyal bsen pho mo'i lag= /bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu'i= /gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad= /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga'i= /lha srin sde brgyad lag= /tshe nyams rnams kyi tshe khug la= /tshe yi rten la bstim du gsol// rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// shar lho me lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags gong bzhin rim par bzla/ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// rin chen lha mo zhags pa ma// phyag na zhags pa 'bar ba bsnams// lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bla tshe khug /man chad gong dang 'gres/ lho nub srin po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// pad+ma'i lha mo lcags sgrog ma// phyag na lcags sgrog 'bar ba bsnams// nub phyogs klu dbang lag=

gong gi 'gres/ nub byang rlung lha'i lag nas dpal= /byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// las kyi lha mo dril bu ma// phyag na dril bu 'bar ba bsnams// byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas bla= /srid pa'i ma mo'i lag= gong gi 'gres so// byang shar dbang ldan lag nas dpal skyobs shig /shar phyogs nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil yangs nas// lā se dkar mo dung phreng can// dbu la rin chen cod pan bcings// phyag g.yas tshe yi g.yab dar bsnams// g.yon na tshe yi bum pa bsnams// tshe mda' srog gi rten du 'dzugs /bla g.yu tshe yi rtags su 'dzugs// tshe dar le brgan g.yab tu 'dor// tshe bum zlum po rten du 'dzugs// shar gyi phyogs nas tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ā yu pha la sid+dhi hūm̐/ 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gres so// lho phyogs nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil yangs nas// mā le sngon mo g.yu phreng can// dbu la rin chen= /phyag g.yas tshe yi= /g.yon na tshe yi= /tshe mda'= /bla g.yu= /tshe dar= /tshe bum zlum= /lho yi phyogs nas= /nub phyogs nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil yangs nas// bī ti dmar mo dbang phreng can// dbu la rin chen= /phyag g.yas tshe= /g.yon na tshe yi= /tshe mda'= /bla g.yu tshe= /tshe dar= /tshe bum zlum= /nub kyi phyogs nas tshe stsol= /byang phyogs nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil yangs= /nīr ti ljang gu gser phreng can// dbu la rin chen= /phyag g.yas tshe yi= /g.yon na tshe yi= /tshe mda' srog gi= /bla g.yu tshe yi= /tshe dar le brgan= /tshe bum zlum po= /byang gi phyogs nas tshe stsol srog= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ā yu pha la sid+dhi hūm̐/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bla tshe nyams pa mi srid kyi// bla tshe sha las nyams gyur na// sa yi khams nas bla tshe khug /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ā yu pha la sid+dhi hūm̐/

bdag cag 'khor dang bcas= /bla tshe= /bla tshe khrag las= /chu yi khams= oṃ āḥhūm̐= zhes sogs gong dang 'gre'o// bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe drod las= /me yi khams= /oṃ āḥhūm̐= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe dbugs las= /rlung gi khams= /oṃ āḥhūm̐= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe sems las= /nam mkha'i khams= oṃ āḥhūm̐= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshes sa las= /sa yi snying po gser yin pas// bla tshe nyams pa gser la bsdu// gser la tshe yi rten mchis so// bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe chu las= /chu yi bcud ni tshwa yin pas// bla tshe nyams pa tshwa= /tshā la tshe yi rten mchis so// bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe rtsi thog las nyams na// rtsi thog snying po mar= bla tshe nyams pa mar= /mar la tshe yi rten= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe me tog las nyams na// me tog snying po sbrang yin pas// bla tshe nyams pa sbrang= /sbrang la tshe yi= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe shing las= /shing gi bcud ni bu ram yin// bla tshe nyams pa bu ram= /bu ram la tshe yi= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe sngo las= /sngo yi snying po 'od ldan= /bla tshe nyams pa 'od ldan= /'od ldan la tshe= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe srog las= /srog gi snying po nṛ yin pas// bla tshe nyams pa nṛ la= /nṛ la tshe yi rten= /bdag cag= /bla tshe= /bla tshe rdo las= /rdo yi snying po g.yu yin= /bla tshe nyams pa g.yu la= /g.yu la tshe yi= /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bla tshe nyams pa mi srid kyi// bla tshe brag las nyams gyur na// brag gi snying po cong zhi yin// bla tshe nyams ba cong zhi la bsdu// cong zhi la tshe yi rten mchis so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ā yu pha la sid+dhi hūm̐/ tshe ni mi 'gyur g.yung drung chos kyi sku ru sba// lus ni mi 'gyur 'byung bzhi'i lus la sba// srog ni mi shigs rdo rje'i sku ru sba// oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ a bh+rūm̐ ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ āḥ de nas tshe chang la dmigs te lha dgu po la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad yan chad ci mang bzla/ de'i rjes la tshe dpag med la bdun rnam dag dang*/ phar phyin drug gi bstod pa bya/ sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi song nas mjug gi cho ga ni/ gtor ma cha lnga yod pa las/ gtor ma dang po de byin gyis brlabs la 'bul ba ni/ tshe dpag med dang phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs la 'bul/ gnyis pa dpal mgon dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo'i tshogs dang rgyal chen bzhi phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul/ gsum pa gzhi bdag dang lhan cig skyes pas gtso byas pa'i grogs byas pa rnams la 'bul/ bzhi pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu la sogs pa gnod byed kyi tshogs su gyur pa dbang bskur ba'i bgegs byed pa rnams la sbyin pa/ gnod pa dang 'gal ba mi byed pa'i bka' bsgo'o// lhag ma mi du yod la glud bsgres la chags che ba dang nyam nga ba thams cad zan la thim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na pa tsa badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag par bsams la/ glud bcos nas re re la btang na rang la nyes dmigs chung bas glud gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha 'dre la// sa gzhi gang ba'i yas 'bul lo// nged kyis 'bul ba ma nor ro// khyed kyis bzhes pa ma 'khrul cig /mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di bzhes la// bzung ba yod na da thongs zhig /bcings pa yod na da khrol cig /hūm̐/ song zhig bgegs chen da song zhig /sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob pas// de ring bdag gis khyed mchod do// sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bu lon lan chags khyer gyur cig /ces brjod la gtor ma phyir rgyag go

/dngos gzhi dbang bskur byed pa la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi 'jug gsum/ sbyor ba la bla ma la gsol ba btab cing bgegs bskrad la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'bog cing*/ phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba gdab pa dang lnga yin/ dang po bla ma la gsol ba 'debs par byed pa khag che/ 'o skol rnams dal 'byor mi lus rin po che thob nas/ dal 'byor yal bar dor bas mi yong ste/ mdo las kyang*/ shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus 'dir// gtan gyi bde ba bsgrub la mi bsgrim par// snyom las don med bya bas g.yengs byas na// de ni skyes bu snying yod ci ltar yin// dus 'dir 'bad na gtan gyi bde thob cing*// mi 'bad sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// gtan gyi bde sdug 'dam du yod pa'i tshe// mi nyid yin na dus 'dir 'bad par rigs// lus ni gdon mi za bar 'chi 'gyur te// shi nas gzhan gyis gtam du 'gyur bar nges// lus ni gdon mi za bar 'jig 'gyur te// sems ni dbang med las kyi 'khrid par 'gyur// don med 'jig rten spongs la don chen bsgrub// 'di dag byas nas phyi nas bsgrub bsams kyang*// bsam bzhin mi yong glo bur 'chi bdag yong*// de ring tsam yang mi 'chi su shes kyi// de ring nyid nas chos la brtson 'grus bskyed// kye ma da lta sa steng gnas pa kun// lo brgya tsam nas gnas skabs ci 'drar 'gyur// 'chi ba'i dus na 'khor dang longs spyod kun// thams cad bor nas gcig pur ga shed 'gro// de tshe chos min cis kyang mi phan pas// ci la bsams kyang chos dang 'gal mi bya// zhes bya bas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir/ dge ba bcu dang du blangs nas/ mi dge bcu spong ba'i dus yin/ chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa la yang bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bsgrub dgos/ bla mas kyang chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba ston dgos/

bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas nas/ gsol ba 'debs dgos pa/ nyid kyi lad mo gyis shig byas nas/ rig sngags 'chang chen dgongs su gsol// bdag ni sdug bsngal las thar phyir// rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor bcas la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang du// bdud 'dul rdo rje can gyis ni// rjes su phrin las gang bsgo ba// de ring de bzhin grub par mdzod// bgegs dang log 'dren tshar bcad phyir// sdug bsngal thams cad nges bsal phyir// khro rgyal khyed kyis byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang nyid khro bor bsgoms la/ de'i thugs ka nas khro bo che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba nas dang til tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro bar bsams la/ nas dang yungs kar gyis brdeg pas/ de rnams khro chung du bsams la/ khro bo che ba rnams kyis bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu phyi'i lcags ri nag po la ded par bsam/ khro bo chung ba rnams kyis nang du zhugs te bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ba spu'i bu ga la phyir bdas par bsam/ de ltar bgegs bskrad nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'bogs pa ni/ rgyal po gang gi 'og tu zhugs nas khrims kyi bya ba la slob pa de bzhin du/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la skyabs su song nas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal ba zhig dgos/ de yang skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang ma 'gal na dam tshig ma nyams pas/ dang po yul gang la skyabs su 'gro na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro na/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral zhing*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas skyabs su 'gro/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su blo bkal nas/ mthor gtong mar gtong jo mo dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam pa'i blo 'gel gyis shig

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rig sngags 'chang chen dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba don dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs bsag pa rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum song*/ de ltar skyabs su song nas/ bslab bya thun mong ma yin pa gsum ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal ba dang*/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod 'tshe spong*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mi mu stegs pa dang mi 'grogs/ thun mong ba lnga ni/ srog dang rtsis dang bya dga'i phyir yang dkon mchog gsum mi spang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la bslab/ dus dus su mchod pa rgya chen po bya zhing*/ rang ci bza' ci 'thung gi phud kyis rtag tu mchod pa la bslab/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams gar 'gro yang*/ phyogs de'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la skyabs su 'gro ba la bslab/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon dran par byas nas/ yang nas yang du skyabs su 'gro ba dran par bya ba la bslab/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ma gtogs pa/ mo bon la sogs thabs gzhan mi btsal ba la bslab/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon la brgyad de/ sdom pa mtha' dag gi rten du 'gyur ba'i phan yon/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la tshud par 'gyur ba'i phan yon/ sdig pa thams cad bsregs shing zad par 'gyur ba'i phan yon/ ngan 'gro log par mi ltung ba'i phan yon/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa'i phan yon/ tshogs thams cad myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phan yon/

myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur ba'i phan yon/ ji ltar bsams pa'i dngos po thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phan yon no// skyabs su song ba'i phan yon la bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mig gis yor yor po zhig tu mthong na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su mi shong ste/ mdo las/ skyabs song bsod nams gzugs yod na// stong gsum 'di yang snod du chung*// rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter// phul gyis gzhal bar lang mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro byas nas sems ma bskyed na sangs rgyas mi thob nges pas/ sems bskyed yod na sangs rgyas yod/ sems bskyed med na sangs rgyas med/ sems mi bskyed na sangs rgyas mi thob nges pa'i 'gro ldog nges pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsams la/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus bya/ yang na rgyas par bya/ seng ge'i sgra bsgrags nas wa'i skad ma 'byin cig dge ba'i rtsa ba khams che chung ci byed kyang rang don mi byed par gzhan don byed dgos/ de la sems bskyed la bslab bya brgyad yod kyang*/ bsdu na 'di la ma 'dus pa med/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par bya snyam pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal dang gral bar bya snyam pa'i snying rje/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral bar bya snyam pa'i btang snyoms/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khod par bya snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i sems bskyed de de rnams dang ma bral bar bya snyam pas gting skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang ma 'gal ba yin/

da phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sems bskyed de dag yod pa la brten nas phyag na rdo rjes byin gyis rlob pa yin pas/ spyi gtsug tu bla ma phyag na rdo rje gong gi ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms la/ rang rang gi bla ma la gsol ba btab/ bla mas phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa'i dmigs pa bya ste/ bla mas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes/ thugs rjes zung la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ phyag na rdo rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ bdag la phyi'i bar du gcod pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ nang gi bar du gcod pa nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnod pa zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur bar byed pa la/ dang po phyag na rdo rje bum pa'i dbang bskur te/ bum pa 'di na dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs bzhugs yod pas/ des dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ khrus mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i khrus ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin pas// ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// dag pa yis ni khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib dag par bsgom/ phyis nas bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir du/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas gnas lngar rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas rdo rje'i go bgo /da ni tshe'i 'brang rgyas kyi dbang bskur bar bya'o// slob ma'i snying gar yi ge hūm̐ ser po zhig bsam/

hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nad gdon thams cad dag par bsam/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig tu bsam/ rdo rje'i steng du 'brang rgyas bzhag pas/ lha rnams kyis rang rang gi bum pa rnams kyi dbang bskur bar bsgoms la/ dbus phyogs seng chen bsnol ba'i khri steng na// rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med// phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'bar ba bsnams// dbus phyogs nam mkha'i bdud bcom mo// g.yon na tshe yi bum pa bsnams// bum pa mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe yi bkang*// kha rgyan mi 'gyur dpag bsam shing*// mgul chings mi 'gyur le brgan rtsi// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// spyi gtsug rtse nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ā yu pha la sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐ yu bh+rūm̐ yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ ā yur dz+nyā na yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ a pa ri mi ta yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye yu tshe bh+rūm̐/ thugs dam bskul ba thams cad kyi gsham du/ rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// spyi gtsug rtse nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod// de ltar dbang bskur nas/ da tshe chang gi dbang bskur ba ni/ phyi tshe bum gyi rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang du yod pa tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yod pas des dbang bskur ba'i mos pa byas te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yis// 'chi med bdud las grol gyur te// rig 'dzin grub pa ma lus pa// tshe yi dngos grub thob par shog /oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur dz+nyā na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ lus la rnam par snang mdzad tshe dbang bskur// 'chi bdag bdud las grol gyur te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /hūm̐ badz+ra satwa ā yur dz+nyā na sid+dhi ā bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

trām̐ rat+na ā yur dz+nyā na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca trām̐/ hrīḥpad+ma ā yur dz+nyā na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ āḥkarma ā yur dz+nyā na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca āḥlus la rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dbang bskur// lus la rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dbang bskur// lus la snang ba mtha' yas tshe dbang bskur// lus la don yod grub pa'i tshe dbang bskur// 'chi bdag bdud las grol gyur te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// dug lnga ma lus dag gyur cig /de'i rjes la/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// zhes pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin drug gi bstod pa bya'o// ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'am/ brtan bzhugs byas la shis pa brjod/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas bum pa dang 'brang rgyas la sogs pa la reg ste/ so so'i dam tshig pa rnams bum chu dang*/ tshe zan dang*/ tshe chang la thim par bsams la/ tshe zan la tshe gzungs tshar gcig brjod la/ 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ slob ma rnams la tshe zan bkram ste/ slob ma rnams kyi lus 'chi med bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la tshe zan la rol/ bsngo bas rgyas gdab/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes/ tshe dpag tu med pas khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsungs pa'i tshe sgrub 'di/ las kyi rdo rje la gnang zhing*/ 'di'i 'brang rgyas kyi gzugs 'di yang*/ rmi lam du bstan pa de bzhin zan la bshams pas shin tu dga' ba zhig byung*/ 'di byas pa la phan yon cher byung ste/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog tu 'dug go /tshe 'di ru tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing*/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye bas/ rang gzhan gyi don du 'di la 'bad pa thon cig glang gi lo lha las babs pa'i skar ma khrums stod kyis nya ba'i nyin par/ dge slong nam mkha'i ming can nam/ ming gzhan las kyi rdo rjes chos grwa chen po dpal gyi thig phyir/

sdom pa gsum ldan kun spang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ 'chi med tshe sgrub dbang chog don gsal 'di gnang ngo*// tshe sgrub 'di la dbang man ngag dang bcas pa yod pas/ yi dam lha yi grangs bsnyen them pa zhig dang*/ dbang thob cing rang gis bdag 'jug brgya rtsa song nas bskur du rung*/ 'di man ngag shin tu zab pas su thod thod la ma sbyin/ yi ge la snon 'bri ma byed/ shin tu zab pas dam par gyis zhes gdams so// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba gang*// thob pa sems can thams cad dang*// khyad par chos mdzad skyes bu rnams// sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan pa dang*// bla med 'bras bu thob par shog/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
